title: Orbs appearing inside Bledsoe's house

tellings.quote: just about every day of my life. and it comes in my house. Orbs appearing in my room over my chairs and flying through the house and stuff.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man, says that since 2007 glowing balls of light called orbs have appeared to him almost every day. He tells Jesse Michels's podcast that they even come into his house, showing up in his room, hovering over chairs and flying through the rooms, which would mean the phenomenon is a constant part of his life.
